protocol.rng: Random(seed*1000+idx) per clip (decode_ab precedent); deterministic arms seeds N/A
protocol.sampler: WIRED_CFG verbatim (T=1.0, top_p=1.0, memo_block_run=2, strict+fsm, lambda=0.0)
protocol.verdict_note: MEASURE ONLY (gate v3 judging is Task 3; no thresholds applied here)
protocol.oracle_method: Human-oracle ceiling (scores only): for each test_locked record the TRUE full ids are scored as a continuation with the frozen scorer — E.score_continuation (whole-record compliance), E.suffix_compliance with the halved prefix_len (the TRUE second half: the compliance ceiling), E.novel_ngram_rate(n=4, whole finalized continuation, same treatment as model cells so values are comparable), and E.longest_verbatim_run (floor prefix_len-7, test-vs-train overlap, measurement only). Committed: means + piece-cluster CIs + this note. Per-record halves are NEVER written to any file (no per-record ids in this JSON, nothing under training/corpus/ or any train-reaching path); outputs live in tools/ only. Deterministic (seeds N/A, n=43).
protocol.nll_method: Proposal P1 (frozen pre-scoring in tools/tests/test_step1_table.py): mask-conditioned NLL renormalized over GRAMMATICALLY-legal ids, i.e. the FSM slot range D.slot_valid_range(slot) for the predicted position (mirrors tokenizer.decode_tokens; parity with baselines._slot_range asserted in training/tests/test_decode.py). The Strict scale/rub mask is semantic, not grammatical, so it is excluded by the word 'grammatically' (strict-inclusive renormalization is a possible follow-up, NOT scored here). Teacher-forced on held-out val composed-* records (composed-O/P k0/k1, n=4, pieces 2: the phase-14 human-composed pool): every predicted position t=1..L-1, NLL_t = logsumexp(logits[allowed]) - logits[true]. Logits sources: v2b = single full-seq forward through the in-memory tap (row t-1 predicts ids[t]); v1 = argmax-only graph, PSEUDO_PEAK pseudo-logits at the greedy id per position (decode_ab.py precedent: the only v1 distribution available); KN = log B._kn_prob renormalized over the same allowed set. Record-mean NLLs compared paired per record with piece-cluster CIs (2 pieces: coarse by construction, reported with this caveat + full per-record table).
protocol.df_method: DF-audit (frozen pre-scoring): train flat-id 8-gram -> set of train PIECES containing it (piece = clip id minus -wNN/-kNN suffix, piece_of(); bare ids like procedural-NNNN are singleton pieces). DF(window) = #pieces. k-eidetic rule fixed a priori (DF_K=2, Sonnet): a train-present window counts as recitation iff 1<=DF<=2 (absent windows are novel, never recitation). Per-clip k-eidetic verdict: max consecutive run of 1<=DF<=2 generated-region windows >=VERBATIM_K(4) (direct §10 analogue in DF space). Committed: FULL DF histogram over ALL memorized generated-region (clip, window) occurrences across the 10 K1 violation clips (not just the verdict) + distinct-window table (window -> DF + pieces). Windows tabulated are MODEL generations (K1 regen outputs), never corpus halves.
protocol.canon_method: Canonical 8-gram index (frozen pre-scoring): train flat-id 8-grams mapped to a transposition-invariant canonical form — all non-Drums pitch tokens minus the window's first non-Drums pitch (bar/sub/track/duration/velocity/head/drums-pitch tokens unchanged; alignment from the window start offset, pitch slot (pos-1)%6==3 with track at pos-1). Exact under uniform non-Drums shifts (clamp at 0/127 breaks exactness; mid-register corpus + shifts<=11 keep it clamp-free, asserted per trial). Flag rule: run of >=VERBATIM_K(4) consecutive canonically-memorized windows (direct §10 analogue in canonical space). Catch: each of the 10 K1 recitations shifted by EVERY s in {0..11} (all transpositions, named set), generated-region floor prefix_len-7. FP: whole-record canonical run>=4 on each of the 256 engine-fresh pool records (bar 0.02 pre-registered; Task 3 judges). Tension disclosed: the gate-v3 amendment bars memorization-probe reuse of the engine-fresh pool; this single frozen-probe measurement (no tuning loop, pool bytes untouched, delta already committed) follows the later, more specific plan+brief directive (FP on engine-fresh) and is disclosed here for Task-3/controller review.
